aed76bc6c89ad481.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Mechanical Engineer / Senior Mechanical Engineer with specialized experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. ae162d43b4f9f711.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Inspector I Structural & Architectural QC for a contract position in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region. This role is responsible for ensuring that all structural and architectural construction activities, including fabrication and erection, are carried out safely, effectively, and efficiently. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with applicable technical requirements, company policies, procedures, and Management System standards. Key Responsibilities Verify the identity of structural materials (plate, beam, angle, etc.) and their conformance to installation drawings and required specifications. Confirm that fit-up and welding inspections have been performed and joints have been released. Verify that dimensions and alignment tolerances of structural components adhere to permissible limits within construction specifications, drawings, and other applicable documents, utilizing advanced dimension check equipment such as EDM, theodolite, and dumpy level. Conduct random surveillance, cross-verification, and in-process surveillance to ensure compliance with applicable and approved specifications, WPS, weld consumables, use of qualified welders, weld processes, and welder performance. Identify project consumable needs and coordinate with the PSCM team to ensure timely ordering and proper management of consumable stock to prevent shortages. Perform walkdown inspections and punch listing for structural components, verifying that punch list items are addressed in accordance with contractual arrangements. Witness final acceptance of structures or associated items, including any applicable final tests as per the contract scope. Complete and endorse all inspection records from initial inspection through to final acceptance of various structural and associated work. Maintain communication with the Client to ensure all contractual and code requirements are met within the inspection scope. Determine and develop all necessary standards and procedures for performing inspections and tests, overseeing all testing methods while maintaining high quality standards for all processes. Develop method statements for activities when necessary, including risk assessment, job safety & environmental analysis, Inspection & Test Plans, and checklists based on project specifications. Compliance and Quality Assurance A core aspect of this role involves ensuring strict adherence to all applicable information security policies and procedures. The Inspector I will play a critical part in maintaining high standards of quality and safety throughout all structural and architectural construction phases, from material verification to final acceptance. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in structural and architectural quality control within a construction or maritime industry setting. Experience with various inspection techniques and equipment, as well as a strong understanding of construction specifications and safety protocols, is essential. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region. The role requires active involvement in construction sites and close collaboration with various teams, including PSCM and the Client, to ensure project quality and compliance.

aef1a5e02ca4b7d1.description: البيانات الوظيفية المسمى الوظيفي: محاسب موقع (Site Accountant). الإدارة: الإدارة المالية. موقع العمل: أحد مشاريع الشركة بمدينة الرياض. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات إعداد ومراجعة مستخلصات مقاولي الباطن ومقاولي تأجير المعدات، والتحقق من مطابقتها للعقود والكميات وساعات التشغيل المعتمدة. مراجعة فواتير ومستخلصات الموردين ومطابقتها مع أوامر الشراء ومستندات الاستلام. إدارة العهد النقدية والمصروفات التشغيلية للمشروع، ومتابعة تسويتها وتصفيتها وفق الإجراءات المالية المعتمدة. المشاركة في إعداد مسيرات رواتب العاملين بالمشروع وتسوية مستحقاتهم، بالتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تسجيل العمليات المالية في النظام المحاسبي، ومتابعة تصنيف وتحميل التكاليف على المشروع. مراجعة ومطابقة كشوف حسابات المقاولين والموردين والعملاء، ومتابعة تسوية الفروقات المالية. إعداد ومتابعة طلبات التحويلات المالية والمصروفات التشغيلية للمشروع وفق الصلاحيات والإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد التقارير المالية الدورية، وتنظيم وحفظ المستندات والسجلات المالية، والتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية وفرق المشاريع. المؤهلات والمتطلبات دبلوم أو بكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية أو تخصص ذي صلة. الوظيفة متاحة لحديثي التخرج، مع أفضلية لمن لديهم خبرة عملية لا تقل عن سنة في محاسبة المشاريع أو قطاع المقاولات. عضوية سارية لدى الهيئة السعودية للمراجعين والمحاسبين (SOCPA). يفضل الإلمام بإعداد مستخلصات المقاولين والموردين وإدارة العهد والتسويات المالية. معرفة بأساسيات المحاسبة المالية ومحاسبة تكاليف المشاريع ومراجعة المستندات المالية. إجادة استخدام Microsoft Excel والأنظمة المحاسبية. الاستعداد للعمل الميداني في مواقع المشاريع بمدينة الرياض. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. التحليل والمراجعة المالية. إعداد التقارير ومطابقة الحسابات. التنظيم وإدارة الأولويات. التواصل والتنسيق الفعّال. حل المشكلات والعمل ضمن فريق. تحمل المسؤولية والالتزام بالمواعيد.

ae46feaa09f331f1.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Senior Electrical Estimation & Design Engineer with over 10 years of experience. The company aims to redefine procurement and supply chain standards, enabling growth across various industrial sectors. This full-time role involves ensuring efficient operations, adherence to safety and compliance standards, and the consistent delivery of high-quality products or services. The Site Director will lead a team, manage resources, and collaborate with various stakeholders to achieve operational excellence and drive continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Lead multiple disciplines within Site Management, determining courses of action based on established principles and modifying existing processes. Develop and execute the site’s long-term strategic plan, ensuring alignment with corporate strategies. Formulate annual business plans for the site and ensure the achievement of financial and strategic objectives. Report to the Chief Operations Officer on activity progress, opportunities, challenges, and mitigation strategies. Manage and continuously monitor site performance to identify deviations and implement necessary resources and actions. Continuously assess and improve operational processes to enhance productivity, reduce costs, and optimize resource utilization. Recommend an optimal organizational structure for the site in coordination with the Chief Operations Officer and Human Capital Department. aee76f7c09617a7f.description: Job description The role of a Production Supervisor (Pipes) is crucial in ensuring that manufacturing processes run smoothly and efficiently. As a leader in the industrial production sector, you will oversee daily operations, manage a team of skilled workers, and ensure that production targets are met while maintaining high-quality standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity for professionals passionate about optimizing production processes and leading teams to success. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team that values continuous improvement and innovation. The company fosters a culture of collaboration, where every team member's input is valued, and opportunities for professional development are abundant. You will have access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and knowledge in production methodologies, safety protocols, and leadership techniques, setting you on a path for career advancement. ae337c59e0a6a1d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية للخدمات البريدية واللوجستية سبل عن أخصائي مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة متخصصة في خدمات ما قبل البيع للحلول الرقمية، ويُعد شاغل الوظيفة مصدرًا للمعرفة للزملاء الآخرين في هذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في إدارة وتطوير المنتجات الرقمية الحالية لـ SPL، بما في ذلك العنوان الوطني، وبوست بيزنس، وتِجاري، بالإضافة إلى عمليات وأنشطة المبيعات الهاتفية لدعم المبيعات وزيادة الإيرادات. تعزيز تبني خدمات العنوان الوطني بما يتماشى مع توجهات وأهداف رؤساء المبيعات ومبادرات النمو. إنشاء شراكات جديدة للمنتجات والخدمات الرقمية مع المحافظة على الشراكات الحالية وتعزيزها، مثل IPL و ELM و Google و GeoKing وغيرها. العمل كنقطة اتصال رئيسية مع IPL فيما يخص المنتجات الرقمية الجديدة، وإدارة أنشطة ما قبل البيع، بما في ذلك عروض الأسعار، والعطاءات، والاجتماعات الفنية، وتنسيق تنفيذ المشاريع، وإدارة الشركاء. المسؤوليات التشغيلية حل المشكلات المعقدة التي قد تؤثر على سير الأعمال. المساهمة في تطوير استراتيجية خدمات ما قبل البيع للحلول الرقمية في سبل. قيادة الفرق أو المشاريع داخل قسم خدمات ما قبل البيع للحلول الرقمية. دعم فرق المبيعات من خلال توظيف الخبرات في المنتجات الرقمية ومنتجات البيانات للمساهمة في تحقيق نمو الأعمال وتوسيع الفرص التجارية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. معرفة متخصصة في مجال خدمات ما قبل البيع للحلول الرقمية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

ae516f6a019b933d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منهج الحقوق عن سكرتير قانوني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير الدعم الإداري المتخصص للمهنيين القانونيين، مع التركيز على تنظيم الوثائق وإدارة المراسلات وجداول المحكمة وحفظ الأرشيف. هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل ومناسبة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى السكرتير القانوني مجموعة من المهام الإدارية والقانونية لدعم سير العمل بكفاءة، وتشمل هذه المسؤوليات ما يلي: جمع وأرشفة المراسلات والوثائق الخاصة بملفات القضايا، مع ضمان حفظ الأرشيف وفقًا لسياسات الاستبقاء المعتمدة. تنظيم وصيانة المكتبات القانونية لضمان سهولة الوصول إلى الموارد. مساعدة المحامين والمهنيين القانونيين في البحث عن المعلومات، مثل المنشورات القانونية والأنظمة وقرارات المحكمة المتعلقة بالقضايا الجارية. إدارة مراسلات الإجراءات القانونية والعقود والنزاعات، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. الدعم الإداري والتقني بالإضافة إلى المهام القانونية، يقدم السكرتير القانوني الدعم الإداري والتقني لضمان بيئة عمل فعالة، حيث يقوم بـ: تنظيف المعدات وأداء الصيانة الأساسية لضمان جاهزيتها. الإبلاغ عن أي أعطال فنية لفنيي الصيانة أو الميكانيكيين المختصين. الاحتفاظ بسجل دقيق للأعمال المنجزة والصيانة الدورية. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحًا يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الوثائق القانونية وإدارة المراسلات بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات. بيئة العمل يعمل السكرتير القانوني ضمن فريق شركة منهج الحقوق في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة ومهنية لدعم العمليات القانونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

Hands-on approach, comfortable working on the press floor and in the cast house. Commercially aware, with an understanding of cost per tonne and how process decisions impact it. Firm in managing suppliers and contractors regarding scope, schedule, and guarantees. ae58c1a63912edb2.description: Duties & Responsibilities Perform or assist in the start-up and shutdown of assigned plants and facilities in accordance with approved operating procedures and instructions. Identify malfunctions or abnormal operating conditions and report them to the Shift Supervisor or Console Operator. Maintain records of field instrument readings and local measurements in logs, and update checklists as required. ae78e575f0ca4731.job_title: Senior Intelligence Consultant, Advanced Intelligence Access
ae78e575f0ca4731.description: Due to national security requirements for this role, applications are strictly restricted to Saudi nationals. Applicants to this role must have work authorization in Saudi Arabia as this role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience working in a government or military environment, leveraging and developing Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) for network, host and log analysis, to enable the detection and response to cyber threats. Experience in leveraging CTI to describe, track and develop new intelligence on advanced persistent threats. Experience in conducting or supporting incident response and investigations within enterprise environments. Preferred qualifications: Experience in SOC operations, threat hunting, detection engineering and SOC workflow optimization. Understanding of core cyber security concepts, common enterprise IT infrastructure components, operating system internals and networking. About the job As a part of the MTIS Social Media Platform team, you will deliver Mandiant Threat Intelligence Services, including its key service known as Advanced Intelligence Access (AIA). You will provide the organization with access to a dedicated Mandiant Intelligence 'Integrator' who acts as an extension of the customer organization. Your team will work within the broader Mandiant Intelligence business and has experience supporting government and commercial sector customers, often working closely with national intelligence services, large government institutions, energy and finance. In this role, you will serve as an AIA Integrator, a highly skilled cyber threat analyst and consultant, backed by the entire organization's support, enablement, and capabilities. As a part of the AIA, you will offer various CTI analytical deliverables like alert-driven threat reports, threat data analysis, briefings, and support to SOC/Blue team functions. AIA Integrators aim to be tightly integrated with their client, working onsite a number of days per week. Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone. Responsibilities Understand customers Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) requirements, identifying their needs and opportunities for deployment of CTI within their operations to have the greatest defensive impact. Evaluate tools and best practices for tracking advanced threats, Tools, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) of attacker’s motivations, and industry and attacker trends. Perform analysis of customer data, taking their bespoke sources to identify threat activity, or to build and automate investigative workflows. Write intelligence reporting against customer requirements, appropriate for their intelligence analysts or executive leaders. Support the integration of CTI into customer's security processes and technologies, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) systems. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

ae074d6cfd6add7b.description: About the Role Mitsubishi Power Saudi Arabia is seeking an experienced Thermal Spray Coating Specialist – APS / HVOF to join their Repair Shop team in Dammam. This full-time role focuses on the precision application of thermal spray coatings on gas turbine components, requiring hands-on expertise in all stages of the coating process. Role Overview The specialist will be responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of thermal spray coatings on gas turbine components. This involves practical experience from initial component preparation and masking to equipment setup, robotic cell operation, and achieving specified coating quality. ae477417e399cbe4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الكحال للخدمات الطبية عن أخصائي بصريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على تجهيز النظارات والعدسات اللاصقة وفقاً لوصفات الأطباء أو نتائج الفحص، بالإضافة إلى صيانة النظارات وإعداد التقارير الفنية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز النظارات الطبية بناءً على نتائج الفحص أو وصفة الطبيب المعالج. اختيار إطار النظارة بالتنسيق مع العميل. تفصيل عدسات النظارات الطبية وتجهيزها وتركيبها على الإطار. تجهيز وتركيب العدسات اللاصقة، وتدريب المرضى على كيفية نزعها وتركيبها وتعقيمها وترطيبها. صيانة النظارات الطبية لضمان جودتها وفعاليتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال البصريات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالبصريات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال البصريات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال البصريات. القدرة على تجهيز وتركيب النظارات والعدسات اللاصقة بدقة. معرفة جيدة بأساليب صيانة النظارات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل فعالة مع العملاء لتقديم الإرشادات اللازمة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي البصريات ضمن فريق شركة الكحال للخدمات الطبية في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل الخدمات الطبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

ae58778f11248107.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Specialist Health and Safety to join Botanica, a subsidiary focused on providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, operating over 1 million square meters with a planet-first approach to sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, shaping the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. This full-time position is based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, and requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The H&S Specialist ensures compliance with occupational health, safety, and environmental policies and guidelines. This role involves advising on measures to minimize hazards and maintain a safe working environment, with a focus on identifying violations and implementing preventive measures. The specialist will contribute to establishing a workplace that meets legal safety standards and fosters a culture prioritizing health, safety, and environment. This position specifically supports the implementation and monitoring of the H&S strategy and management within the nursery subsidiary. Key Responsibilities Compile and maintain safety programs, ensuring compliance with all safety regulations and standardizing H&S practices. Conduct workplace inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential health, safety, and environmental hazards, recommending appropriate control measures. Support the development and review of job safety analyses and risk assessments. Initiate, organize, and perform H&S training for employees, contractors, and visitors. Conduct regular staff meetings to promote a safety culture, encouraging safe work practices and recognizing employees who follow safety guidelines. Correct unsafe acts or conditions through established lines of authority. Develop and implement emergency response plans and coordinate emergency drills. Stop any unsafe acts or processes deemed dangerous or unhealthy. Record and investigate incidents to determine causes. Prepare reports on occurrences, compile and maintain relevant registers, and provide statistical information to management. Promote a positive safety culture by fostering employee engagement, recognition, and continuous improvement in HSE performance. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience as an H&S Professional. In-depth knowledge of relevant legislation (*, OSHA/EMS, Saudi Arabia’s HSE, COSHH, Confined Space, Lifting Operations, Excavations) and HSE procedures. Knowledge of potentially hazardous materials or practices. Experience in writing reports and developing policies/guidelines for health, safety, and environment. Familiarity with conducting data analysis and reporting statistics. Proficient in MS Office applications (*, PowerPoint, Excel, MS Word); working knowledge of safety management information systems is a plus. Certificate in occupational health, safety, and environment. Required Skills Enthusiasm and consistent attention to detail. Good communication skills to explain safety procedures and regulations clearly and concisely. Outstanding organizational skills. Ability to present and explain health, safety, and environment topics effectively. Work Environment This role offers the opportunity to contribute to world-class projects in sustainable tourism and development within a natural setting. The team includes passionate professionals, with 40% from the local community, fostering an environment committed to ecological harmony and pioneering new global benchmarks in sustainable development.

ae6c78b66d85c9e6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث معهد همم للتدريب عن مدرب مهني للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط التدريسية والتدريبية في مجال التخصص، مع متابعة وتقييم أداء المتدربين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المدرب المهني مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان جودة العملية التدريبية وفعاليتها، وتشمل: إعداد خطط التدريس النظري والتدريب العملي في حقل التخصص. متابعة تجهيز وتشغيل معامل أو ورش التدريب العملي. تدريس المواد النظرية والتدريب على الجوانب العملية والتطبيقية. دراسة وتحليل مناهج علوم المهنة والتدريب المهني وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية. إعداد قوائم مستلزمات معامل أو ورش التدريب، بما في ذلك الكميات والمواصفات، وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات. تصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التربوية وطرق وأساليب التدريس الفعالة. تنفيذ وإدارة الدروس النظرية وتصميم الاختبارات النظرية لقياس تحصيل الطلبة. إعداد وتنفيذ وإدارة خطط الدروس والتطبيقات العملية. تنظيم التطبيقات العملية والميدانية للطلبة وتصميم الاختبارات العملية لقياس الأداء. تطوير أساليب التدريس وأدوات القياس والتقويم، ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال الاختصاص. تقييم أداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم، وإعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بتقدمهم. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب المهني أو التعليم الفني. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير الخطط التدريسية والتدريبية. مهارات ممتازة في التدريس النظري والعملي. القدرة على تقييم أداء المتدربين وتحصيلهم الدراسي. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية لإدارة الفصول وورش العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب المهني في معهد همم للتدريب بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في بيئة تعليمية وتدريبية ديناميكية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

ae7f72976c92e3db.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking an EHS Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The EHS Supervisor will be responsible for overseeing and implementing all Environmental, Health, and Safety protocols across assigned projects. Key Responsibilities Prepare all EHS-related documents, including EHS plans, emergency response plans, and risk assessments. Attend EHS meetings with clients and project teams, reporting all EHS-related issues to the Head Office. Provide EHS induction training to new workers and conduct daily EHS inspections for assigned zones. Ensure appropriate safe work permits are obtained by Engineers/Supervisors from Clients/Main Contractors. Conduct site-wide risk assessments, informing Site Engineers and/or Clients/Main Contractors of high-risk areas. Ensure Engineers deliver weekly toolbox talks to workers to promote EHS awareness. Verify that all personnel wear required personal protective equipment, including helmets, EHS shoes, and coveralls. Ensure equipment such as ladders and scaffolding are in good working condition before use. Maintain satisfactory health and hygiene conditions for workers, including access to water, rest areas, and adequate lighting and ventilation. Ensure proper housekeeping on project sites to prevent incidents and accidents. Conduct Job EHS Analysis on high-risk activities to minimize hazardous conditions. Encourage workers and engineers to implement EHS practices. Conduct investigations with engineers for minor or major incidents/accidents and communicate results for future precautions. Administer first-aid or seek medical assistance in case of worker injury. Maintain all documentation related to EHS activities. Establish, monitor, appraise, and coordinate an upgraded integrated health, safety, and environment management system (conforming to ISO-45001:2018, ISO14001:2015, and ISO 9001 standards) for construction projects, improvising procedure manuals and internal audits based on these standards. Conduct EHS training programs for engineers and workers on-site and participate in HR-organized EHS training programs. Perform hazard identification and risk assessment for critical activities, ensuring method statements incorporate findings. Prepare EHS Plans and Environment Management Plans. Coordinate external EHS audits and third-party inspections of equipment. Prepare Emergency Preparedness Plans and conduct emergency drills. Facilitate the implementation of the Work Permit System. Coordinate occupational health and welfare measures. Prepare EHS conditions of contract for sub-contractors. Stop work if unsafe practices are witnessed and promote a "don’t walk by" and "commitment to action" attitude. Carry out monthly project Risk Management Audits and quarterly system audits. Provide EHS reports to the project head and IC Head on the current status of EHS performance. Qualifications and Requirements ARAMCO approval as an EHS Supervisor is mandatory. Proven experience in the Oil and Gas sector. 5-10 years of relevant experience in EHS supervision. Strong understanding and practical application of EHS regulations and standards. Ability to prepare comprehensive EHS documentation. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for training and coordination. The role requires active engagement on-site and close collaboration with project teams, clients, and contractors to ensure adherence to stringent EHS standards.

ae3b280dd4569885.description: About HCLTech HCLTech is a global technology company with over 219,000 employees across 54 countries. The company focuses on driving progress through industry-leading capabilities and fostering a diverse, creative, and passionate workforce. The Role HCLTech is seeking an L3 Mainframe MQ / CICS System Administrator to join the team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires an experienced professional with strong expertise in IBM MQ on z/OS and working knowledge of CICS system administration. The administrator will be responsible for L3 production support, administration, troubleshooting, performance management, incident resolution, system changes, and technical problem management for the Mainframe MQ environment. The position involves independently handling complex technical issues, performing root-cause analysis, and collaborating with application, infrastructure, and vendor teams. Key Responsibilities IBM MQ (Primary Skill): Provide L3 administration and production support for IBM MQ on z/OS, including managing Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, and Listeners. Perform MQ configuration, maintenance, parameter changes, and environment management. Troubleshoot complex MQ connectivity, message flow, queue, channel, and transaction-related issues. Analyze MQ errors, logs, dumps, and system messages for root cause identification. Monitor queue depth, channel status, message backlogs, performance, and resource utilization. Handle MQ startup/shutdown, recovery activities, and configuration changes. Support MQ upgrades, maintenance, PTFs, and software lifecycle activities. Manage MQ security, including RACF-related access and authorization. Troubleshoot MQ-CICS integration and application connectivity issues. Support MQ high-availability, disaster recovery, and recovery procedures. Perform root-cause analysis (RCA) for recurring and critical MQ incidents. Develop and maintain operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation. Participate in major incident, problem management, and change management activities. CICS (Secondary Skill): Provide L2/L3 administration and technical support for IBM CICS Transaction Server on z/OS. Support CICS regions, startup/shutdown, and system configuration. Troubleshoot CICS transaction, region, resource, and connectivity issues. Analyze CICS messages, logs, dumps, and related system information. Support CICS resource definitions and configuration changes. Troubleshoot MQ-CICS integration and transaction processing issues. Support CICS performance monitoring and tuning activities. Assist with CICS upgrades, maintenance, and PTF implementation. Collaborate with application and middleware teams to resolve complex CICS production issues. Mainframe / z/OS Responsibilities: Demonstrate a strong understanding of the IBM z/OS operating environment and good knowledge of JES2, JCL, SDSF, and system logs. Ability to analyze SYSLOG, job output, dumps, and diagnostic information. Work with Storage, DB2, Security/RACF, Network, and Application teams for cross-platform issue resolution. Participate in planned maintenance, system changes, and production deployments. Follow ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management. Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and mentor junior administrators. Required Experience and Competencies 8–12+ years of overall Mainframe experience, with significant hands-on experience in IBM MQ administration. Strong L3 production support experience. Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience handling Severity 1 / Severity 2 incidents. Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple technical teams. Ability to work in a 24x7 support / on-call environment, if required. Experience working in enterprise/large-scale Mainframe environments. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position. HCLTech operates a virtual-first work environment, promoting work-life integration and flexibility. The company is a certified great place to work and a top employer in 17 countries, valuing employee recognition and respect. HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees.

aebf9e2cc5a89068.description: ABIS is seeking a qualified Coating Supervisor for our Oil & Gas industry projects. The Coating Supervisor will be responsible for overseeing the application of coatings to infrastructure and equipment, ensuring compliance with project specifications, safety regulations, and quality standards. This role involves directing coating crews, coordinating with quality control inspectors, and monitoring the progress of coating activities on-site. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing coating operations within the oil and gas sector and a strong commitment to safety and quality assurance. Responsibilities Supervise day-to-day coating operations to ensure timely and quality completion. Coordinate with site engineers, QA/QC teams, and contractors to fulfill project requirements. Ensure all coating activities adhere to safety policies and environmental regulations. Conduct inspections to monitor surface preparation, coating application, and curing processes. Maintain accurate documentation and reports related to coating works. Train and mentor coating crew members to improve performance and compliance with procedures. Identify and resolve issues during coating operations to minimize downtime. Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Coating Technology, or related field preferred. Minimum 3-5 years of experience supervising coating activities in the oil and gas industry. In-depth knowledge of coating materials, surface preparation, and application techniques. Familiarity with industry standards such as NACE, SSPC, and relevant safety regulations. Strong leadership and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in high-pressure and fast-paced environments. Attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.

aeb366b49950dec5.description: The E & I Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical and instrumentation systems. The role includes ensuring system integrity, supporting cathodic protection systems, and maintaining compliance with operational and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Perform maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and instrumentation systems. Maintain and monitor cathodic protection (CP) systems to ensure pipeline and asset integrity. Execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities for E&I systems. Inspect, test, calibrate, and maintain instruments such as transmitters, control valves, analyzers, and protection systems. Maintain electrical systems including motors, switchgear, MCCs, transformers, and power distribution systems. Support plant and pipeline operations by ensuring reliable E&I system performance. Participate in shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance activities. Ensure compliance with HSE standards, permit-to-work systems, and regulatory requirements. Prepare maintenance reports, technical documentation, and work orders. Coordinate with operations teams, contractors, and vendors during maintenance activities. Use SAP PM for maintenance planning, execution, and reporting (preferred). Qualifications & Experience Education: University degree in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering. Experience: 5–8 years of experience in maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and instrumentation. Proven expertise in cathodic protection systems. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems in plant and pipeline environments. Experience with CP system design, monitoring, and troubleshooting. SAP PM experience preferred. Skills & Competencies Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good understanding of electrical safety standards and procedures. Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Effective communication and reporting skills. High attention to detail and commitment to safety and reliability.
